name: Genaya Connect
description: Hosted MCP server for Genaya, an operations app for service businesses: ask about appointments, clients, invoices, calls and tasks, and prepare changes that run only after the member confirms them. OAuth 2.1 sign-in; paid plans with a 14-day free trial. Endpoint: `https://api.genaya.com/mcp` · [Website](https://www.genaya.com)
